## Decision or model boundary changed

Describe the case, solver, evaluator, audit gate, sensitivity rule, report, or packaging behavior affected.

## Verification

- [ ] Complete release gate passes
- [ ] New model behavior has a positive and negative test
- [ ] Feasibility and objective are independently recomputed
- [ ] Stress tests and implementation ownership are present
- [ ] Public examples remain synthetic
- [ ] No heuristic is labeled optimal
- [ ] No real operational, employee, customer, route, or investment data were added

## Maturity claim

State exactly what is reference-solver validated, adapter-dependent, or still outside the model.
